verdict.rationale: Event webhooks are a fair question for a self-hostable AI email app, but the pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The only programmatic surface is an MCP tool list for pull-style actions (get threads, send emails, modify labels), and an independent review notes there is no public HTTP API at all. The vague 'Developer-Friendly – integrations' tagline does not establish webhook support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
